name: Singapore Health Services (SingHealth)

scam_info.sample: Heard news about SingHealth or one of its institutions that you’re unsure of? Email us at checkfakenews@singhealth.com.sg to verify its authenticity.
scam_info.notes: Verification channel only (official email checkfakenews@singhealth.com.sg). Polyclinic equivalent at https://polyclinic.singhealth.com.sg/about-shp/news/check-fake-news (seen in search, not opened). Sitemap index (7 children, lastmod) has no other scam page; scam alerts for SingHealth institutions live on sgh.com.sg (separate record). Unverified (search snippet): ScamShield flagged fake 'SingHealth Polyclinics' outstanding-bill iMessages on 7 Nov 2026; SPF advisory 'Beware of Fake SingHealth and Polyclinic Websites' (SPF sample domain polyclinic-a.top, not visited).

notes: Public healthcare cluster (MOH Holdings-owned; parent set to moh.gov.sg). official_domains: singhealth.com.sg (b) + SingHealth institution sites linked from the SingHealth footer (b): CGH, KKH, SKH, NCCS, NHCS, NNI, SNEC, NDCS, EGH, HealthXchange, SingHealth Academy, SingHealth Duke-NUS; sgh.com.sg has its own record. Official bill-payment host per SGH page: eservices.healthhub.sg/public/payments. SPF brand tag 'SingHealth' (1 advisory).

name: Singapore General Hospital

scam_info.sample: Only log in to make a payment at this secure link on the MOH HealthHub portal, never elsewhere: https://eservices.healthhub.sg/public/payments ... Examples: https://sgh-xxx.com.sg or https://sgh-sgauth.com
scam_info.notes: Fake-link PATTERN examples (sgh-xxx.com.sg placeholder, sgh-sgauth.com) plus the single OFFICIAL payment URL (eservices.healthhub.sg/public/payments). Undated. 'A link can contain the word "SGH", "SingHealth" or "HealthHub" and still be fake.'

scam_info.sample: Verify SGH's official website is www.sgh.com.sg and government sites use .gov.sg
scam_info.notes: 'Scam Alert: Protect Yourself from Healthcare Impersonation Scams' - narrative + official-website statement (a). Unverified (search snippet): SGH also flagged a fake YouTube ad claiming an eye-drop product was developed by SGH (Nov 2026).

scam_info.sample: Beware of fake advertisements featuring individuals dressed in Singapore General Hospital’s (SGH) or NHG Health garb to promote health products that have been circulating online
scam_info.notes: Republished Straits Times article (7 Jul 2026) on fake TikTok ads impersonating SGH/NHG Health staff. No handles given.

notes: official_domains sgh.com.sg (a: 'SGH's official website is www.sgh.com.sg'). eservices.healthhub.sg is the official bill-payment host named by SGH (a; HealthHub record). sgh.com.sg robots/sitemap not swept.

name: National University Health System

scam_info.sample: Beware of Rising Impersonation Calls, SMSes and Email Phishing Scams Created: 27 January 2022 Updated: 1 April 2026
scam_info.notes: Single advisory, narrative (enter credentials only on NUHS App or official websites; verify via www.nuhs.edu.sg/about-nuhs/contact-us). Site-wide banner 'NUHS Institutions will NEVER ask you to transfer money or disclose bank details over a call.' Sitemap (2,131 URLs) has no lastmod. Legacy URL /Pages/security-advisory.aspx (search).

notes: Public healthcare cluster. official_domains: nuhs.edu.sg (b) + cluster institution sites linked from NUHS nav/footer (b): NUHS Plus, Ng Teng Fong GH, Alexandra Hospital, Jurong Community Hospital, NCIS, NUHCS, National University Polyclinics, NUCOHS; nuh.com.sg has its own record.

scam_info.sample: NUH will NEVER ask you to transfer money or disclose bank details over a call. We also do not endorse, sell or promote products on social media.
scam_info.notes: Dated 2024/06/21. Narrative; official verification channels: 6908-2222, contactus@nuhs.edu.sg, OneNUHS App. Still cites retired scamalert.sg and 1800-722-6688 anti-scam helpline.

name: NHG Health (National Healthcare Group)
notes: BLOCKED: www.nhghealth.com.sg returned HTTP 429 to robots.txt, /sitemap.xml and homepage (curl), and HTTP 429 via WebFetch (2026-11-26); legacy www.nhg.com.sg also 429 (2026-11-25). Stopped per policy, not bypassed. Domain taken from search results (www.nhghealth.com.sg/, /ncid, /nhg-diagnostics) - not confirmed on an opened page. Known scam info (via SGH-hosted ST article, 7 Jul 2026): NHG Health Facebook post (6 Jul 2026) warned of videos of an individual in NHG uniform selling medical products. Cluster covers TTSH, KTPH, Woodlands Hospital, IMH, NSC, NCID, NHG Polyclinics.
